from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanySharesData(BaseModel):
    """Weighted-average diluted shares outstanding from one company's filing."""
    company: str = Field(description="The company name from the filing")
    diluted_shares_value: float = Field(description="The weighted-average diluted shares outstanding value")
    unit: str = Field(description="The unit the value is expressed in (e.g., 'thousands', 'millions', 'exact', or blank for no unit)")
    period: str = Field(description="The reporting period this figure covers (format: YYYY-MM)")
    source_page: str | None = Field(description="Page number where the data is disclosed")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_shares_data: list[CompanySharesData]
